aarti.tek: Victory to you, Bhagavad Gītā; Mother, victory to you, Bhagavad Gītā, who dwell in the lotus of Hari's heart, beautiful and most holy.
aarti.pad1: You reveal the true heart of action and take away desire and attachment; you make the knowledge of truth unfold; you are the supreme knowledge of Brahman. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: You grant unwavering devotion; you are pure and take away impurity; you impart the secret of surrender, and bring happiness in every way. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: You tear apart attachment and aversion, and ever bring joy; you take away the fear of worldly existence, carry us across, and give supreme bliss. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: You destroy the demonic nature and the night of darkness; you bestow the divine virtues, a companion who delights in Hari. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: You teach equanimity and renunciation, the word from Hari's mouth; you are the mistress of all scriptures and the queen of the Vedas. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: You who shower the nectar of mercy, Mother, be gracious; grant me love for Hari's feet and make me your own. ॥6॥
